packageRules.description: One weekly PR for routine updates. Majors stay separate: they are the ones that break.
Patch and digest updates merge themselves once CI is green.
Pin Dockerfile images by digest, so a rebuild cannot pull different layers while git stays unchanged.
yt-dlp and ytmusicapi track YouTube's changes: an old version stops downloading or searching. Update them as soon as a release lands, not on the weekly schedule, and merge on green.
Only patch releases and digest updates of Python 3.12.
